DIAGNOSIS READY: Cervical Spondylotic Myelopathy.

The history of chronic burning pain, paresthesias, progressive bilateral hand weakness, and your risk factors (age, diabetes) strongly point to cervical spine cord compression rather than a simple nerve root issue or systemic infection.
